scope: Reusable business configuration plus generation, validation, rendering, and QA of B2B and enterprise proposal artifacts.
autonomous_envelope: Generate and validate proposal artifacts from a configured, hash-bound business profile with no unresolved fields. External sending or publishing is outside this envelope and requires separate external-write controls.

idempotency.reason: The autonomous envelope ends at local proposal artifact generation and validation; external writes are not authorized by this skill.

rollback_or_compensation.reason: The autonomous envelope produces local replaceable artifacts and does not perform irreversible external mutations.

concurrency_control.reason: This skill does not authorize concurrent external mutations; callers own output-path locking if multiple proposal jobs write to the same local path.

limitations: Autonomous client release requires a separate browser/PDF/screenshot visual QA mechanism; static HTML checks alone are not treated as proof of no overflow or clipping.
Sending, publishing, CRM updates, or other external writes are outside this skill's autonomous envelope.
